## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `develop` (only release PRs target `main`)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `flutter analyze` has no issues
- [ ] Unit / widget tests added or updated, and passing
- [ ] Generated code is up to date (`dart run build_runner build`)
- [ ] Follows the feature layers (presentation / domain / data)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or keystores in the diff
